failures.signal: Detail production begins from a reference image without target use, scale, engine, platform, budgets, material, LOD, collision, deformation, delivery, or rights decisions.
diagnosis: Trace each production choice to a declared input.
Mark assumed values and identify their owners.
failures.repair: Stop at a reversible blockout, return a missing-input packet, and resume only after the relevant contract is accepted.
failures.evidence_reset: All work based on guessed production targets remains provisional.

failures.signal: The target import shows gradients, seams, faceting, or normal-map changes absent from the source view.
diagnosis: Compare final triangles, normals, tangents, smoothing, UV seams, mirrored shells, and importer recomputation.
Use a neutral diagnostic material and representative lighting.
failures.repair: Align the source and target triangulation/tangent contract, rebake the exact final low mesh, re-export, and re-import.
failures.evidence_reset: Invalidate dependent bake, material, visual, and target-import passes.

failures.signal: Bake maps show projection misses, skew, waviness, gradients, seams, contamination, or insufficient mip padding.
diagnosis: Inspect cage/ray distance and high/low alignment by region.
Check naming groups, UV boundaries, padding, resolution, tangent basis, and final triangulation.
failures.repair: Repair the localized source, cage, UV, naming, or bake setting and rerun downstream material and target inspection.
failures.evidence_reset: Invalidate affected maps and every material/export derived from them.

failures.signal: The target renderer changes roughness, metal response, normal intensity, alpha, color, emissive, or channel behavior.
diagnosis: Compare material model, shader mapping, texture channels, transfer functions, compression, sampler, mip, alpha, and import settings.
Separate lighting/exposure differences from asset-data differences.
failures.repair: Produce a declared target material variant or request shader/graphics ownership; do not hide the mismatch with presentation lighting.
failures.evidence_reset: Invalidate cross-renderer equivalence claims and refresh target captures.

failures.signal: The imported asset is mirrored, rotated, incorrectly scaled, offset, unsnappable, or unusable for intended attachment.
diagnosis: Inspect units, axes, handedness, transforms, export conversion, importer conversion, bounds, origin, pivot, hierarchy, and socket data.
Test against a known-scale target fixture.
failures.repair: Apply the target conversion once, restore intended pivot/hierarchy, and rerun export/import and placement tests.
failures.evidence_reset: Invalidate placement, collision, LOD bounds, socket, and visual-scale evidence.

failures.signal: A reduced mesh meets the numeric target but pops, collapses silhouette, changes shading, breaks material boundaries, or loses gameplay readability.
diagnosis: Observe transitions at representative FOV, distance, motion, lighting, and screen size.
Compare protected features, UV/material boundaries, sockets, bounds, and collision assumptions.
failures.repair: Rebuild or constrain reduction around critical features and coordinate transition settings with technical and visual owners.
failures.evidence_reset: Keep the budget measurement but mark visual acceptance failed until fresh inspection.

failures.signal: Collision is missing, blocks an intended opening, allows penetration, behaves unstably, or costs more than the target allows.
diagnosis: Inspect target-side collision primitives, convexity, intersections, transforms, naming, bounds, and trace/use requirements.
Run the relevant physics or gameplay fixture.
failures.repair: Revise the simple collision candidate and request gameplay/physics validation; never infer behavior from viewport fit alone.
failures.evidence_reset: Invalidate collision and play-context evidence only; preserve unrelated visual evidence.

failures.signal: The candidate is called game-ready because it validates and imports without errors.
diagnosis: Build a matrix for source, structural, visual, runtime, performance, collision, deformation, gameplay, art, and rights evidence.
Identify missing owners and representative contexts.
failures.repair: Narrow the claim to structural validation/import and keep game readiness blocked until required evidence arrives.
failures.evidence_reset: No existing valid evidence is deleted, but unsupported acceptance is withdrawn.

failures.signal: The asset is polished alone but conflicts with accepted family scale, silhouette language, density, wear, palette, roughness, or modular rules.
diagnosis: Compare beside accepted family members in the target context.
Check shared constraints and distinguish authored variation from accidental drift.
failures.repair: Restore family constraints or request an explicit direction change; rerun context comparison.
failures.evidence_reset: Individual craft evidence remains; family and direction fidelity fail until reviewed.

failures.signal: A generated, traced, scanned, baked, converted, or heavily modified source is treated as cleared because its final form differs.
diagnosis: Trace every input, provider, author, license/terms capture, consent, modification, and intended distribution.
Identify protected references, trademarks, likenesses, or restricted datasets.
failures.repair: Block release, request IP review, and replace inputs whose permitted use cannot be established.
failures.evidence_reset: Rights status remains BLOCKED; technical and visual evidence may be retained but cannot authorize release.
